title: Randomized three-coordinate majority tree
statement: There is a randomized decision tree for majority on three inputs taking values in $\\{-1,1\}$. Its seed is uniform on the three-element set $	ext{Fin}(3)$, and each seed selects the corresponding pair-first tree; every selected tree computes majority exactly on every input.
